limitations: Blood concentrations were obtained directly from HPA summary annotations (Conc. blood IM and Conc. blood MS in pg/L) where measured; missing concentration records indicate an absence of measurement or detection within the respective assay cohort rather than true biological absence.

RNA tissue consensus expression is reported in normalized transcripts per million (nTPM) as relative abundance across tissues; differences between tissues reflect relative expression profiles rather than absolute cellular transcript counts or secretion rates.
